senses.gloss:
अदन अद् + अन, n. Eating, Man. 11, 64.
 --Comp.

आदान आदान, i. e. आ-दा + अन, n.
 1. Seizing, Vedāntas. in Chr. 209, 20. Seizure, Kumāras. 5, 11; Man. 7, 204.
 2. Taking, receiving, Man. 11, 15. Receipt, Rājat. 5, 265.
 --Comp.

अ- + दान अ- + दान,
 I. n. 1. non-payment, Man. 8, 5. 2. illiberality, Pañc. ii. d. 74.
 II. adj. illiberal; and, without the fluid which flows from the temples of an elephant in rut, Pañc. ii. d. 73.
अदम्भित्व अदम्भित्व, i. e. अ-दम्भिन् + त्व, n. Sincerity.

अदस् अदस्, pronoun, nom. sing. m. and f. असौ, nom. and acc. sing. n. अदस्; the bases of the remaining cases are अमु, अमू, and अमी. That, you, Man. 10, 128. It is preceded by the relative pronoun, He-who, Man. 1, 7.
अदायिक अदायिक, i. e. अ-दाय + इक, adj. For which there are no heirs.

ऽआद -आद, i. e.
 I. अद् + अ, adj., f. दी, Eating, e. g. पुरुषाद, i. e. पुरुष-, Eating men. पृष्ठ-मांस-, m. A backbiter, a slanderer. मानुष-मांस-, Eating men's flesh, Hiḍ. 2, 2.
 II. आ-द (vb. दा), adj. Taking.
ऽआदक -आदक, i. e. अद् + अक, adj. Eating, e. g. पुरुष-, Eating men, Hiḍ. 2, 30.

आदर आदर, i. e. आ-द्रि + अ, m.
 1. Regard, Kumāras. 6, 13.
 2. Concern, Pañc. iii. d. 262.
 3. Care, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 10.
 4. Love, Pañc. iv. d. 7 (आदरात्, passionately).
 5. Interest, Daśak. in Chr. 190, 8.
 6. Respect, Kir. 5, 16.
 --Comp.
अ- + दार अ- + दार, adj. unmarried, Rām. 4, 18, 15.
आदर्श आदर्श, i. e. आ-दृश् + अ, and आदर्शक आदर्श + क, m. A mirror, Bhag. 3, 38.

आदातृ आ-दा + तृ, m. A receiver, Man. 4, 193.
 --Comp.
अ- + दातृ अ- + दातृ, m. 1. one who gives no present, Man. 11, 15. 2. one who is not obliged to pay, Man. 8, 161. क्षीर-दात्री, f. yielding milk, MBh. 13, 4919.
आदानवन्त् आदान + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Taking away, MBh. 3, 8501.

आदायिन् आदायिन्, i. e. आ-दा + इन्, adj., f. नी.
 1. Taking, MBh. 12, 5969 (अ-सम्-मत-, taking without assent, a thief).
 2. Robbing, Man. 7, 123.
 3. Bringing, Rājat. 5, 272.
अ-दक्षिण अ-दक्षिण, adj. 1. left, Rām. 6, 29, 10. 2. foolish, 3, 24, 13. 3. devoid of presents, Pañc. ii. d. 101.
अ-दण्ड्य अ-दण्ड्य, 1. not to be punished, Man. 8, 335. 2. innocent, 8, 128.
अ- + दभ्र अ- + दभ्र, adj. Great, Bhāg. P. 8, 3, 19. Excellent, 1, 15, 15.
अ- + दम्भ अ- + दम्भ, 1. m. sincerity, Rām. 2, 86, 2. 2. adj. sincere, Hariv. 4137.
अ-दय + म् अ-दय + म्, adv. passionately, Vikr. d. 147.

अ- + दर्शन अ- + दर्शन,
 I. n. 1. not seeing, Rām. 5, 53, 6. 2. neglect, Man. 10, 43. 3. disappearance, Rām. 3, 50, 11; with गम्, to disappear, Pañc. 137, 21; with नी, to cause to disappear, Rām. 5, 22, 2.
 II. adj. invisible, Arj. 8, 28.
अ- + दायाद अ- + दायाद, f. दा, not being a heir, Man. 9, 158; 8, 160.
अ- + दास अ- + दास, m. not being a slave, Man. 10, 32.
आदर्श- + मण्डल आदर्श- + मण्डल, 1. the reflection of a mirror, Kir. 5, 41. 2. a kind of snake, Suśr. 2, 265, 11.
